rows.label: tlk70000077_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I just got notice from
the Superbian army.

rows.label: tlk70000077_05_msg0002
rows.name:
The Iiran Divine Beast has awakened
and shown its true form...

rows.label: tlk70000077_05_msg0003
rows.name:
To be honest, I don't know how we're
supposed to respond to a situation
like this.

rows.label: tlk70000077_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Maybe attaching machinery to Divine
Beasts and trying to control them
however we liked was arrogant of us.

rows.label: tlk70000077_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Anyway, I'm convinced that what I do
for a living is still the right thing
for humans and Divine Beasts.

rows.label: tlk70000077_05_msg0006
rows.name:
So please, everyone... Iira, by the
hands of those who live alongside
it...

rows.label: tlk70000077_05_msg0007
rows.name:
Please save the Divine Beast that
lives alongside people!
